attribution.note: The sentence is in the third person, but it appears in Marcus's own Substack post as his closing line. It is his own claim, not a quote of anyone else.

semantics.note: 'Will not see AGI by 2029' is firm, unhedged language, so this is a scored forecast. The criteria qualifier and the 'by 2029' horizon are both kept in the drafter's version.

contract.note: The contract uses the five tasks and three-of-five threshold from the linked bet page, which is what Marcus pointed to. Reading 'by 2029' as through Dec 31, 2029 is ordinary. One caveat: the single-system clarification on the linked page is dated only 'June 2024'. Since nothing settles the outcome yet, this does not change the result.

evidence.note: A benchmark leaderboard updated 2026-10-22, before the evaluation date. It shows partial coding results and says its tests cannot cover all inputs. It does not test three capabilities in one system, so it is context only.

reviews.rationale: This is a firm forecast with a deadline of 2029-12-31, which is after the evaluation date. The early-resolution rule only allows an early 'contradicted', and only if one system is shown to meet three of the five criteria. The packet has no such evaluation. Missing successes before the deadline do not count as support, so the forecast cannot be scored yet.
